note: fixtures for pipeline.OrtOCR.assemble (step 130); arrays are zlib+base64 of raw little-endian bytes (see tools/scripts/test/gen_assemble_fixtures.py)

split_line.name: wide_cut
split_line.note: the 90px gap is over 3 * h = 60: cut

split_line.name: wide_no_cut
split_line.note: the same gap under gap=5: 5 * h = 100, no cut

split_line.name: at_cut
split_line.note: a gutter cut between f and g, right after the space

split_line.name: at_equal
split_line.note: `at` equal to a token x: the strict inequalities keep it in one piece

split_line.name: split_two
split_line.note: two cuts, one from the gap and one from `at`

split_line.name: every_pair_cut
split_line.note: gap 0.1 * h = 2: every neighbouring pair is cut

split_line.name: blank_ids
split_line.note: vocab id 0 is the CTC blank and decodes to nothing: all segments dropped

split_line.name: tiny_box
split_line.note: zero height: h clamps to 1.0, so 3 * h = 3 and 90 > 3

gutter_cuts.name: gutter
gutter_cuts.note: edges line up within half a line height

order_backtracks.name: two_columns
order_backtracks.note: up to the second column: none

order_backtracks.name: backtrack
order_backtracks.note: the last line jumps back up on the left: one

order_backtracks.name: overlap_not_column
order_backtracks.note: up but horizontally overlapping: not a backtrack

order_backtracks.name: two_backtracks
order_backtracks.note: down, up, down, up: two backward moves

pdf_order_coherent.name: two_lines
pdf_order_coherent.note: two lines: the model-agreement check never runs
